# D-127 (2026-11-03)

## Decision

**Generated files are generated, never committed; each lane keeps its own LANES file** (product
owner, through the coordinator, 2026-11-02; plan approved as written). `openapi.json`,
`api-client/src/schema.ts` and `backend/app/shared/labels/resources.json` are ignored by git.
`make generated` writes them (`make setup` runs it; `generated-backend` needs Node only,
`generated-frontend` the backend venv and pnpm); the frontend's lint, typecheck, test and build
scripts write them when missing; CI writes them before tsc and the tests, and before the image
builds, which stay offline and refuse to build without them. The OpenAPI breaking-change check
exports the target branch's contract from that branch's code. Still committed:
`docs/architecture/event-schemas.json` (few conflicts), `docs/architecture/openapi-accepted-breaks.json`
(the hand-written D-095 list) and `frontend/packages/labels/src/rtl-ranges.json`. After the first
external API release (D-095, WP-041) each release publishes its OpenAPI contract as a release
artifact rather than a committed file. `docs/LANES.md` becomes the index, the QA lock and the
rules; each lane's row is its own file, `docs/lanes/A.md`, `B.md`, `C.md`.

## Rationale

After D-123, the most frequent merge conflicts were the generated files (13 on 2026-11-02:
`openapi.json` 4, `schema.ts` 4, `resources.json` 5) and the LANES table (5). A generated file has
nothing to merge: it is regenerated from the code. One file per lane removes the table conflicts.

## Affected docs

Makefile, .gitignore, .github/workflows (ci, cluster, stack-smoke, perf, audit-scale,
report-scale), .github/actions/generated, deploy/images (backend, web), docs/dev-setup.md,
docs/architecture/api-conventions.md, docs/architecture/module-template.md, docs/LANES.md,
docs/lanes/; CLAUDE.md §3 (D-022 line: "CI fails if it is out of date") wording pending the
product owner
